info.title: ReplyNodes Fetcher API
info.description: SDK contract for ReplyNodes public, read-only data operations. Every SDK operation is an authenticated HTTP GET.

bearerAuth.description: API key. Paste the raw key only (e.g. rn_test_...) — the "Bearer " prefix is added automatically.

X-Request-Id.description: Correlation identifier returned by the gateway and echoed in meta.request_id.

words_count.description: Word count reported by the rendered page metadata, when available.

get.summary: Look up one public App Store application
get.description: Look up one public App Store application. Returns the normalized public contract; raw provider records are internal to the runtime boundary and never cross the public gateway.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric track id; provide this or appId.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: Bundle id; provide this or id.

get.summary: Extract public brand identity for a site
get.description: Extract logos, colors, fonts, and basic public metadata for a site's brand identity.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Target URL to fetch. Rejected if it is malformed, uses a disallowed scheme, or resolves to a private/loopback/link-local/cloud-metadata address.

402.description: x402 challenge or prepaid-credit top-up required

get.summary: Crawl same-origin links from a URL
get.description: Crawl same-origin links starting from a URL and return normalized page results. max_pages/max_depth are clamped server-side regardless of the requested value.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Target URL to fetch. Rejected if it is malformed, uses a disallowed scheme, or resolves to a private/loopback/link-local/cloud-metadata address.

parameters.name: max_pages
parameters.description: Maximum pages to crawl; clamped to 1..50.

402.description: x402 challenge or prepaid-credit top-up required

get.summary: Fetch one URL as clean Markdown
